card.name: Author name before their book title
card.fires_on: Small marks like 's or a comma right after a nonfiction author's name, or a year, where the book title is about to come. Seen in book reviews and author credits.

modes.label: After author name
modes.description: The 's or comma straight after an author's name, just before the title of their book.
modes.example: Published in July of 2012. The Violinist's Thumb does for DNA what Sam Kean<<'s>> first book, The Disappearing Spoon

modes.label: Year of a work
modes.description: Digits or the word work in a year phrase naming an author's book, or a copyright line.
modes.example: His 200<<4>> work Big Breasts and Wide Hips

card.writes: It pushes toward words like memo, translator, Pulitzer and HBO, which fit author and book-credit text.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to name an author's book, right after the author's name or the year.
